capabilities: Open files by extension in a chosen external application
Map file extensions to application paths
Set a default app for unmapped extensions
Ignore specific file types such as .md, images, video
extras: Installation requires manually copying main.js to the plugins directory or building from source; no listing in the community plugin store is mentioned.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to choose which application opens a given file extension; non-Markdown files like .py or .yaml can't be routed to an external editor.

requires.name: external applications installed on the user's machine

summary: Extension mapper that opens non-Markdown vault files in custom external applications configured per file type.
